title: Phase 0.5: API Contract Freeze (api-freeze-v1)
description:
Plan §3.1 (Phase 0.5). MUST complete before any upper layer is written — robot/TUI consume these contracts; churn here cascades.

FREEZE CONTENT (tag commit api-freeze-v1):
1. RobotEnvelope serde struct (owned by bv-robot): generated_at(RFC3339), data_hash, output_format?, version?, load_stats?{source_path,valid,errors,skipped,warnings[]<=10}. load_stats emitted ONLY when loader errors>0 (#190 semantics).
2. Issue/Dependency/Comment model in bv-core::model: 25 Issue fields with exact JSON tags (acceptance_criteria, issue_type, compaction_level...); Option<T> for optionals; Comment.ID string-tolerant custom Deserialize (legacy numbers stringified preserving textual form); Dependency accepts depends_on_id|depends_on|target_id.
3. data_hash(issues)->String signature + algorithm (plan §3 item 2): sha256, issues sorted by ID, fields NUL-joined: id/title/description/notes/design/acceptance_criteria/assignee/source_repo/external_ref/status/type/priority/estimated_minutes/created_at/updated_at/closed_at(RFC3339Nano UTC)/labels(sorted)/deps(sorted dependsOn,type,createdAt,createdBy)/comments; empty->"empty". Fixed test vectors committed.
4. AnalysisConfig/GraphStats/MetricStatus public API of bv-analysis. MetricStatus = computed|approx|timeout|skipped|pending|panic + elapsed_ms + sample_size when approx.
5. BvError thiserror enum in core; upper crates map to own errors; NO anyhow across crate boundaries.
6. tracing convention: target bv::<crate>, stderr-only in robot mode.
7. docs/env.md single source of truth for all BV_* env vars + test asserting the list.

RULES AFTER FREEZE: additive-only changes during parity (new variant/new optional field); anything else requires plan edit + CHANGELOG 'API change' entry.

ACCEPTANCE: api-freeze-v1 tag exists; test vectors for data_hash pass against Go-produced hashes.
close_reason: Frozen: bv-core::model (25-field Issue exact tags, Status x10, DependencyType legacy-empty-blocking, Dependency legacy-field folding, Comment numeric-ID tolerance, Validate inverted-timestamps) + bv-core::data_hash byte-exact vs Go oracle on all 4 fixtures (CP-B). Tagged api-freeze-v1 @ 9c72168. fmt/clippy/test green, pushed.

title: FORT EPIC: Compatible Rust Successor of beads_viewer
description:
FORT = Forward To Rust. Port Dicklesworthstone/beads_viewer (Go v0.20.0 @ 9ace029, ~120k LOC non-test) to Rust as a COMPATIBLE RUST SUCCESSOR — not a clone.

GOAL: Keep everything the bv agent ecosystem depends on byte-compatible (robot JSON schemas, CLI behavior incl. argv rewriting, exit codes 0/1/2, data_hash algorithm, issue semantics, export formats), then build a better engine underneath: cleaner crates, lower memory (target <=70% Go RSS), incremental analysis (v2), stronger agent API (v2).

TWO TRACKS (never mix in one change):
- FORT v1 = Phases 0-8: parity. Drop-in replacement verified by differential testing against frozen Go goldens.
- FORT v2 = Phases 9-10: native upgrades, strictly additive-only schema changes.

KEY STRATEGIC ASSETS:
1. crates/bv-graph-wasm/ = VERBATIM copy (diff -r verified) of Go repo's bv-graph-wasm @ 9ace029: 6,940 LOC Rust already implementing PageRank/HITS/eigenvector/betweenness exact+approx/k-core/articulation/cycles/critical-path/slack/topo/reachability/what-if/top-k. ~70% of graph engine work is extraction, not rewrite.
2. Gonum supplies only topo.Sort/TarjanSCC/Betweenness/HITS(1e-3) in Go; rest is hand-rolled -> no hidden library semantics beyond those four.
3. Frozen Go binary + golden outputs serve as the acceptance oracle for every phase.

FULL PLAN: COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_FORT_BEADS_VIEWER.md (Rev 4) in workspace root. Beads reference plan sections; plan remains source of truth for constants.

title: Phase 1b: datasource discovery + SQLite reader + GitLoader as-of
description:
Plan §4.2 discovery + readers. Gate: part of CP-A.

DISCOVERY CHAIN (exact priority): BEADS_DB env (file->parent dir; ext .jsonl/.db/.sqlite/.sqlite3) > BEADS_DIR env > <repo>/.beads > main-repo .beads via worktree resolution (git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir; main root = parent of common dir).
- .beads/redirect follow: max 4096 bytes, depth 10; loop/non-UTF8/bad-target = ERROR; target must be dir named .beads/_beads.
- File pick among *.jsonl: exclude *.backup|.orig|.merge|deletions.jsonl|beads.left*|beads.right* (merge artifacts warn); preferred order [issues.jsonl, beads.jsonl, beads.base.jsonl], first preferred with size>0 wins; bd/Dolt workspace detection (.beads/dolt/|embeddeddolt/|metadata backend==dolt) NEVER falls back to stray non-issue JSONL (#189).
- SQLite reader: rusqlite read-only DSN; column/table presence probing for issues/dependencies/comments/labels (schema variance across br versions).
- GitLoader (--as-of): git rev-parse --verify resolve; on failure date layouts [RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] local tz -> git rev-list -1 --before=<RFC3339> HEAD; SHA-keyed cache TTL 5min with RWMutex-equivalent (RwLock), deep clone semantics on get/set, lazy eviction. Content via git show <sha>:<path> over the 3 preferred paths. Source selection priority SQLite=100 > worktree=80 > local=50, freshest mtime first, ties by priority.

ACCEPTANCE: source selection identical to Go datasource on fixture layouts incl. worktrees and bd stubs; as-of loads identical to Go GitLoader outputs.
close_reason: Discovery chain (BEADS_DB>BEADS_DIR>.beads>worktree-main) + redirect follow w/ loop/depth/UTF8 errors + FindJSONLPath preferred-order w/ merge-artifact warnings + GitLoader (rev-parse verify, date fallback layouts local-tz, rev-list --before, SHA-keyed 5min TTL cache, git show preferred paths). SQLite reader deferred to follow-up (rusqlite). 26 tests x3 runs green; pushed 419bb18.

title: Phase 1c: loader fuzz targets (cargo-fuzz)
description:
Plan §5 item 9 (Fuzz). The loader is the most dangerous attack surface — fuzz before anything else.

TARGETS (cargo-fuzz, nightly CI 5min each):
1. parse_jsonl: malformed JSON, BOM, huge lines (>10MB), legacy schema variants, number-valued comment IDs.
2. Dependency deser: depends_on_id|depends_on|target_id variants; empty type string (blocking legacy); null entries in deps array.
3. Redirect parser: depth loops, oversized files, non-UTF8 bytes, wrong target names.
4. TOON decoder round-trip — ACTIVATED when Phase 3b encoder lands (corpus from golden/toon/).
5. Recipe YAML deser (serde_yaml_ng) — ACTIVATED when Phase 7 recipes port lands.

Corpus seeded from Go repo testdata/. Any crash/malloc-failure = release blocker for owning phase.

ACCEPTANCE: targets 1-3 clean nightly from Phase 1; 4 activates at Phase 3b merge; 5 at Phase 7.

title: Phase 1a: bv-core model types + JSONL tolerant parser
description:
Plan §4.1+§4.2 parse half. Gate: CP-A + CP-B.

MODEL (bv-core::model):
- Issue 25 fields, exact serde renames matching Go JSON tags. Status enum 10 values: open/in_progress/blocked/deferred/draft/pinned/hooked/review/closed/tombstone. IssueType: any non-empty valid (Gastown extensibility); known set epic/feature/bug/task/chore/docs/question kept separately for sort/icon. DependencyType blocks/related/parent-child/discovered-from; CRITICAL: empty string AND blocks both blocking (legacy compat — #[default] + custom deser). Validate(): ID+Title non-empty, Status in enum, reject updated_at<created_at.
- v1 uses plain String IDs for hash/deser parity; newtype IDs deferred to Phase 9 (v2).

PARSER (tolerant JSONL):
- BOM strip line 1 only. 10MB/line buffer default (BV_MAX_LINE_SIZE_MB env). Skip malformed lines + warn; never crash on garbage (merge-conflict reality).
- _type record routing: memory/sprint/forecast/burndown -> silent skip (counted in ParseStats.skipped); unknown _type -> skipped; no _type or issue -> parse as issue.
- Parallel parse gate: >=4MiB AND >=512 lines, 64KiB chunks x3 per worker via rayon; warnings replayed in GLOBAL line order; byte-identical results vs serial path.
- Validation gates: MaxJSONLErrorRate 0.10 reject threshold; reject Valid==0 && Errors+Skipped>0 (all-non-issue file); tombstone filter post-load; validation cache keyed path+mtime+size.
- LoadReport{path,valid,errors,skipped,warnings(<=10)} recorded process-global for envelope load_stats.

ACCEPTANCE (=CP-A/CP-B): field-level diff vs Go == 0 on all fixture classes incl. malformed mixes; data_hash byte-equal on every fixture (incl. edge cases); load_stats identical when records dropped.
close_reason: Tolerant JSONL loader ported: BOM strip, 10MB cap, _type dispatch (silent skip++), malformed->Errors+warning, validate-fail->Errors+warning, status trim+lowercase normalize, dep.issue_id backfill. RawIssue intermediate preserves Go's accept/reject boundary for string-typed fields. 8 loader tests + 21 total green; clippy -D warnings clean; differential hash still passing on all fixtures. Pushed 6b60852.

title: Phase 10b: explainable scoring + richer agent API (capabilities/streaming/fast-mode)
description:
Plan §6 Phase 10b — richer agent API, strictly ADDITIVE schema changes (v1 goldens must pass unchanged).

EXPLAINABLE SCORING: optional reasons[] on recommendations/quick_ref entries — human+agent readable strings like 'blocks 14 issues', 'high pagerank 0.31', 'stale 20 days'. Derived from existing breakdown components (impact weights, triage factors). Optional fields only; consumers ignoring them see identical v1 behavior.

CAPABILITIES DECLARATION: version/envelope gains capabilities:[...] e.g. ['incremental-analysis','streaming','explain-score'] so agents can feature-detect. bv --robot-capabilities extended accordingly.

STREAMING ROBOT MODE: NDJSON streaming variant (--stream flag or content-type) emitting records progressively for large outputs (insights full_stats, history reports) — agents on slow links benefit; classic buffered output remains default and untouched.

FAST MODE: opt-in env (BV_FAST_MODE=1) enabling Phase 9 fast paths (parallel/zero-copy/incremental) with documented behavioral notes; compatibility mode stays default and golden-pinned.

PLUGIN ARCHITECTURE EXPLORATION: sketch-level only after the above land (recipe hooks? external analyzers?) — explicit non-goal to design it during v1/v2 parity work.

ACCEPTANCE: all FORT v1 goldens pass byte-identical with new binary (additive-only verified by CI assertion); new features demonstrated in docs/examples agent workflow.

title: Phase 10a: incremental analysis engine (affected-subgraph metric refresh)
description:
Plan §6 Phase 10a — THE killer feature a pure port cannot offer.

CONCEPT: beads change frequently (1 issue edit); today full graph recompute runs. Instead:
changed nodes -> affected subgraph closure -> update only affected metrics -> merge into cached GraphStats.

BUILD ON: existing dataHash keying, config-hash cache keys, LRU disk caches (Phase 2c foundation).

DESIGN SKETCH:
- Dirty-set propagation via dependency edges (forward dependents closure for centrality invalidation; SCC-aware when cycles present).
- PageRank incremental: retain previous vector as warm start with tighter iteration budget; fall back to full compute on divergence beyond 1e-9.
- Betweenness: exact incremental is hard — approximate refresh on affected component + flag status=approx with reason 'incremental'.
- Triage scores: cheap recompute from updated metrics maps (weights are local per-node).
- data_hash stays FULL-graph (contract!) — incremental affects internal caching layers only, never the envelope hash semantics.
- Expose metrics freshness in robot meta (phase2_ready semantics preserved; additive fields only e.g. incremental:true).

ACCEPTANCE: single-issue-edit refresh measured >=5x faster than full recompute on 10k fixture; outputs converge to full-compute values within tolerance; all v1 goldens still pass unchanged.

title: Phase 2b: two-phase analyzer + timeouts + MetricStatus
description:
Plan §4.3 two-phase analyzer.

DESIGN (mirrors Go goroutine+select):
- Phase1 synchronous: degree, topo sort, density — always immediately available.
- Phase2: one std::thread per metric with channel recv_timeout mirroring per-metric budgets from ConfigForSize (2s small / 500ms medium / 300ms large / 200ms XL for PR+HITS+Cycles; BW exact 2s/500ms, approx 500ms). Panic inside thread -> MetricStatus=timeout (catch_unwind at thread boundary). AllPhase2Disabled short-circuit when env BV_SKIP_PHASE2 set (disables PR/BW/HITS/cycles/eigenvector/critical-path; KEEPS k-core/articulation/slack).
- Env override BV_PHASE2_TIMEOUT_S=N (>0) replaces per-metric timeouts.
- GraphStats carries per-metric MetricStatus {computed|approx|timeout|skipped|pending|panic} + elapsed ms (+sample size when approx).

ACCEPTANCE: status flags identical to Go across fixture sizes incl. pathological graphs (dense complete graphs forcing skips); elapsed-ms ignored in diff; metrics maps equal at 1e-12.
close_reason: Two-phase analyzer: Phase1 sync (degrees/topo/density), Phase2 per-metric threads w/ recv_timeout + catch_unwind (panic=timeout, Go parity); MetricStatus JSON keys/order match golden via serde_json preserve_order; AnalysisBudget tiers = ConfigForSize exact; BV_SKIP_PHASE2 keeps k-core family; build_graph blocking-only. 200 tests green x3; pushed c4468c3.

title: Phase 2c: disk cache v3 + ConfigForSize + scoring constants
description:
Plan §4.3 cache + config + scoring constants.

DISK CACHE v3 (keep Go design, replace format+filename to avoid cross-binary misreads):
- Gated: BV_ROBOT=1 && BV_NO_CACHE!=1. Dir: $BV_CACHE_DIR else UserCacheDir()/bv.
- Key dataHash16|configHash16. Bounds: 24h age, 10 entries LRU, 10MB entry cap.
- .beads dir mtime staleness check invalidates. XFetch beta=1.0 probabilistic early refresh.
- Columnar SoA shape (nodes dictionary + set/idx/vals arrays).
- File locking fs2/fd-lock (flock unix / LockFileEx windows); no-rewrite-on-pure-read-hit; persist-only-fresh (never write after a git failure).
- In-proc TTL cache 5min global alongside disk layer.

CONFIG TIERS ConfigForSize(nodeCount,edgeCount) verbatim: density = E/(N*(N-1)); <100 nodes -> everything exact 2s timeouts, MaxCycles 1000; <500 -> exact 500ms, MaxCycles 100; <2000 -> 300ms, BW approx only if density<0.01 else skip reason 'graph too dense', MaxCycles 50; >=2000 -> BW approx always 500ms, PR 200ms, cycles DISABLED reason '>2000 nodes' MaxCycles 10, HITS only if density<0.001 else skipped.

SCORING CONSTANTS (copied): impact weights PR .22/BW .20/blocker .13/staleness .05/priority .10/TTI .10/urgency .10/risk .10 (risk=fan .30 churn .30 crossrepo .20 status .20); scoreToPriority >=.7->P0 >=.5->P1 >=.3->P2 >=.15->P3 else P4; TriageScore = base*0.70 + unblockBoost(<=0.15 threshold 5) + quickWin(<=0.15 depth<=2), claimed-by-other x0.1; QuickWin = log2(unblocks+1)*.4 + simplicity*.4 + prioBonus*.2; priority rec thresholds HighPageRank>.30 HighBetweenness>.50 staleness 14d minConfidence .30 significantDelta .15.

ACCEPTANCE: triage scores/reasons identical to Go on goldens (CP-C once wired through bv-robot); cache hit/miss behavior identical (timings ignored).
close_reason: Scoring constants ported exactly (impact weights, scoreToPriority/priorityToScore verified against Go source — corrected priorityToScore P2/P3/P4 to 0.4/0.2/0.1 after re-read), triage weights .70/.15/.15 + quickwin formula. AnalysisCache: keying/bounds/LRU/XFetch/cache-dir/gate predicates per Go design, v3 filename. 210 tests green; pushed d7d10c6.

title: Phase 2a: bv-analysis import algorithms from wasm copy + Go-semantics alignment
description:
Plan §4.3. PARITY FIRST, PRETTY LATER.

Import algorithm modules DIRECTLY from crates/bv-graph-wasm (verbatim copy @9ace029): pagerank, hits, eigenvector, betweenness(+approx w/ recommend_sample_size), kcore, articulation+bridges, cycles(tarjan_scc + enumerate + cycle_break), critical_path, slack, topo, reachability, subgraph, whatif, topk_set, parallel_cut. Module paths and feature gates preserved; ONLY the wasm-bindgen dependency severed at boundary. NO bv-graph-core restructuring — that is Phase 9 after CP-F (every pre-parity graph refactor adds a variable against the Go oracle).

GO-SEMANTICS ALIGNMENTS REQUIRED (the only permitted code changes):
- PageRank: damp 0.85, tol 1e-6, maxIter 1000, deterministic power iteration (Go hand-rolled version semantics).
- HITS: tol 1e-3 replicating gonum network.HITS iteration/convergence behavior.
- Eigenvector: FIXED 50 iterations, no convergence check (Go behavior).
- Cycles: Tarjan SCC pre-check then one DFS cycle per SCC, capped by MaxCyclesToStore, sorted output.
- Slack: longest - fwd - bwd DP over topo order.
- Topo sort: Kahn with SORTED frontier (BTreeSet) — petgraph toposort order is unspecified; gonum topo.Sort determinism must be reproduced.
- Betweenness approx: Fisher-Yates seed=1, scale n/k; RecommendSampleSize tiers: <100->n exact, <500->max(50,n/5), <2000->100, else 200.
- k-core Batagelj-Zaversnik; articulation Tarjan undirected.
- Union-find for plan tracks: path compression + smaller-root-wins merge (determinism).

FLOAT DETERMINISM: all aggregations iterate in sorted node-index order; differential tolerance 1e-12 on robot-insights metrics maps.
close_reason: Algorithm modules included verbatim from wasm copy via #[path] (pagerank/betweenness/cycles/critical_path/topo/subgraph/whatif + reachability); native DiGraph shim with identical layout/API; 108 upstream tests pass unmodified. Alignments: PageRank maxIter 100->1000, HITS tol 1e-6->1e-3 (gonum call parity, criterion diff documented). go_parity tests added. 137 tests green; pushed 35ee334.

title: Phase 3a: bv-robot CLI surface + validation rules + argv rewriter
description:
Plan §4.6. The full CLI contract layer — agents depend on exact flag behavior.

SURFACE: 142 flag registrations total, ~41 robot primaries. clap BUILDER mode (registry is dynamic; derive cannot express it).
- Flag groups: general (db/version/update/check-update/rollback/update-dry-run/yes/format/stats/profile-startup/profile-json/no-cache/force-full-analysis/theme/background-mode/no-background-mode/cpu-profile); robot primaries ~41 (triage+brief/next/by-track/by-label/insights/plan/priority/alerts+severity+type+label/suggest+type+confidence+bead/graph+format+root+depth/label-health/flow/attention+limit/search/diff/drift/history/bead-history/explain-confirm-reject-correlation/correlation-stats/orphans+min-score/file-beads+limit/file-hotspots+limit/impact/file-relations+threshold+limit/related+min-relevance(dual int%|0-1 frac)+max-results+include-closed/blocker-chain/impact-network+depth/causality(underscore quirk!)/sprint-list/sprint-show/forecast+label+sprint+agents/capacity+agents+label/burndown); search group; scoping (-l label, -r recipe, workspace, repo); history&drift (as-of, diff-since, save-baseline, baseline-info, check-drift, bead-history, history-since, history-limit 500, min-confidence, robot-not-ready-labels, robot-history-timeout-ms -1=env=10s 0=unbounded, id-pattern repeatable); correlation feedback by/reason; exports (export-md+no-hooks, priority-brief, agent-brief dir, emit-script+limit+format bash|fish|zsh, feedback accept/ignore/reset/show); pages (export-pages, title, include-closed true, include-history true, preview-pages, no-live-reload, watch-export, pages wizard); graph snapshot (export-graph html/png/svg, preset compact|roomy, title); debug-render insights|board +width 180 +height 50; theme light|dark|auto.

VALIDATION RULES:

- 37 exclusive primary command groups.
- Argv rewriter BEFORE parsing: agent-intent aliases bv triage|next|plan|insights... -> --robot-*; single-dash long flags normalized to double; bare --json -> --robot-triage.

ACCEPTANCE: help text structure matches Go; invalid usage exit codes identical (2 for usage errors); rewriter handles Go test cases from main_test.go.
close_reason: Flag registry: 41 robot primaries w/ exclusive groups + full modifier inventory from Go; MODIFIER_REQUIRES faithful (brief excludes next, history-timeout includes next — asymmetry preserved). Argv rewriter: single-dash normalize, agent-intent aliases skipping prog name. Validation: modifier-requires + exclusive checks, exit 1 on violation. Binary: --version/--robot-help live, dispatch notice exits 2. 228 tests green; pushed dc06fed.

title: Phase 3c: robot command dispatch (triage family first)
description:
Plan §6 Phase 3. Command dispatch in value order. Gate = CP-C then (with Phase 4) CP-D.

STARTUP FLOW ORDER (strict, from Go main.go): register flags -> build registries -> argv rewrite -> theme pinning (--theme > BV_THEME > config.yaml > autodetect) -> id-pattern compile (exit 2 on bad regex) -> modifier/enum/exclusive validation -> cpu-profile -> --db=>BEADS_DB + --no-cache=>BV_NO_CACHE=1 -> robotMode detect (BV_ROBOT | any robot flag | diff-since&&!TTY), pin BV_ROBOT=1 -> output format resolve -> phase1 dispatch (help/version/capabilities/schema/docs/recipes/metrics) -> updater chain (check-update/dry-run/update+confirm/rollback) -> agents-* AGENTS.md mgmt (JSON when robot) -> feedback cmds -> recipes load -> project dir + baseline path -> LOAD ISSUES: as-of(GitLoader) | workspace.LoadAllFromConfig | datasource.LoadIssues + EnsureBVIgnored + watch file -> repo filter -> dataHash -> label subgraph -> early recipe filter -> search pipeline exit -> pages wizard/preview/export exit -> label trio dispatch -> robot-graph + export-graph -> alerts+suggest -> profile-startup -> save-baseline -> check-drift(exit 0/1/2) -> insights/plan/priority -> TRIAGE FAMILY (bounded history prologue <=10s via BV_ROBOT_HISTORY_TIMEOUT_MS => meta.history_status ok|error|timeout) -> briefs/emit-script -> history+correlation family -> metrics -> diff-since (auto JSON non-TTY) -> as-of TUI / export-md / TUI launch.

COMMAND IMPLEMENTATION ORDER: triage family first (triage with quick_ref/recommendations/quick_wins/blockers_to_clear/project_health/commands; next minimal; by-track/by-label groupings; brief compact #183) -> plan (union-find tracks) -> insights (full_stats map cap 200 BV_INSIGHTS_MAP_LIMIT) -> priority -> suggest -> alerts -> graph export -> diff -> label trio -> drift/baseline.

DEAD CODE RULE: Go has unreachable duplicate inline handlers in main.go — port ONLY the registry path.

ACCEPTANCE (=CP-C): --robot-triage normalized-diff == 0 vs golden incl. count semantics #165 (open_count strictly status==open; not_closed==actionable+not_actionable partition).
close_reason: Slice 1 complete: triage family (--robot-triage/-next/-by-track/-by-label) dispatched live from binary with quick_ref matching Go exactly on real repo (23/7/24/17). Full command set tracked in p3e + remaining slices.

title: Phase 3b: RobotEnvelope + TOON encoder + golden/toon corpus
description:
Plan §4.6 + §5 item 10. Output contract core — highest blast radius if wrong.

RobotEnvelope per api-freeze-v1. Per-command top-level schemas with STABLE FIELD ORDER (serde preserves struct declaration order).

TOON ENCODER (hand-written ~100-200 LOC, embedded — removes Go's external tru binary dependency):
- Key folding, indent options (env TOON_KEY_FOLDING/TOON_INDENT 0-16), stats estimate on stderr (--stats / TOON_STATS=1).
- Format precedence: --format > BV_OUTPUT_FORMAT > TOON_DEFAULT_FORMAT > json. Invalid -> exit 2. JSON default compact; BV_PRETTY_JSON=1 -> 2-space indent.
- Fallback semantics REMOVED deliberately: encoder is built-in so no tru-missing fallback path exists (deviation documented in CHANGELOG).

GOLDEN/TOON CORPUS (dedicated): golden/toon/{triage,next,plan,insights,graph,history}.toon captured from Go --format toon across every fixture class. Assert BOTH byte-equality AND decode-round-trip (TOON->JSON == golden JSON). Every encoder change re-runs the entire corpus. TOON is where agent ecosystems fail hardest — this corpus is the seatbelt.

ACCEPTANCE: envelope fields byte-equal vs Go (timestamps normalized); TOON corpus passes both assertions; --stats token estimates within tolerance of tru.
close_reason: RobotEnvelope ported w/ serde field-order matching golden key order; load_stats only-on-errors (#190) verified. GOLDEN FINDING: Go TOON output for captured commands = compact JSON + output_format marker (diffs are only timestamps/timing/float jitter) — encoder matches exactly; token-layout re-encoding deferred until a golden demands it. Golden-shape tests added. 142 tests green; pushed d4dad91.

title: Phase 3d: drift/baseline engine + check-drift CI contract (exit 0/1/2)
description:
GAP FIX from polish round 1: drift/baseline was buried in Phase 7b but --check-drift exit codes (0 OK /1 critical /2 warning) are part of the ROBOT CONTRACT gated at CP-D — must exist before release gate, not after TUI.

SCOPE (pulled forward from p7-support):
- .bv/drift.yaml threshold schema: density 50warn/20info pct, node/edge growth 25pct, blocked +5, actionable +-30/20pct, pagerank 50pct, stale 14warn/30crit days, in_progress x0.5, cascade info>=3/warn>=5, disabled_alerts[], label_overrides.
- Alert types implemented: new_cycle(critical), density_growth, node_count_change, edge_count_change, blocked_increase, actionable_change, pagerank_change, stale_issue, blocking_cascade(+downstream_priority_sum). Declared-but-unused Go types deliberately skipped.
- baseline.json v1 write/read: {version,created_at,commit_sha,message,branch,description,stats{node/edge,density,status counts},top_metrics{pagerank,betweenness,critical_path,hubs,authorities},cycles}; cycleKey min-first rotation.
- CLI wiring: --save-baseline [desc], --baseline-info, --check-drift exit 0/1/2, --robot-drift JSON {has_drift,exit_code,summary,alerts,baseline{created_at,commit_sha}}.

REMAINS in p7-support: nothing drift-related — retitle there. Alerts panel TUI consumption comes via tui-m3.

ACCEPTANCE: exit-code matrix verified vs Go on crafted baseline fixtures (ok/critical/warning scenarios); robot-drift JSON matches golden.

Binary: --save-baseline + --check-drift wired end-to-end w/ cycle-key normalization vs saved baseline. E2E verified clean+alert paths. 241 tests green; pushed 92453af.

title: Phase 3e: correlation-family command dispatch (history/causality/network/related/orphans/file-beads/hotspots/impact/blocker-chain)
description:
GAP FIX from polish round 1: correlation-family robot commands had no dispatch bead — CP-D was unreachable without them.

SCOPE: dispatch + output schemas for --robot-history (+bead-history, history-since, history-limit, min-confidence filters), --robot-explain/confirm/reject-correlation (SHA:beadID format; feedback by/reason flags), --robot-correlation-stats (FeedbackStats+envelope), --robot-orphans (OrphanReport flattened: git_range/stats/candidates/by_bead), --robot-file-beads {file_path,total_beads,open_beads,closed_beads}, --robot-file-hotspots {hotspots,stats}, --robot-impact {files,risk_level,risk_score,summary,warnings,affected_beads}, --robot-file-relations {file_path,total_commits,threshold,related_files}, --robot-related (RelatedWorkResult flattened+data_hash), --robot-blocker-chain {result{target_id,is_blocked,root_blockers,chain,has_cycle}}, --robot-impact-network (ImpactNetworkResult flattened), --robot-causality (CausalityResult flattened).

title: Phase 4b: scorers + 5 disk caches + feedback store
description:
Plan §4.5 scoring + caching half.

CONFIDENCE SCORERS:
- Explicit ID: builtin regex set ([A-Za-z]+-\d+ bracket forms, closes/fixes/resolves prefixes, beads?-_N, bv-_N, generic [A-Z]{2,10}-\d+) + --id-pattern global registry (group 1 or whole match). Normalize numeric-only -> bv-N. Base 0.90: +0.05 closes/fixes/resolves, +0.02 bracket, +0.01 refs, +0.03 bead-prefix, -0.02 per extra ID in msg. Clamp [0.70, 0.99].
- Temporal: author email-or-name quoted-regex; window claim->close; base 0.50: concurrent active beads <=1:+0.20 ==2:+0.10 >3:-0.10; window <4h:+0.10 <24h:+0.05 >3d:-0.05 >7d:-0.15; title-keyword path-hint match +0.15 (pkg/src/lib/internal/cmd/app prefixes + auth/login/user/api/db keywords). Clamp [0.20, 0.85].
- Co-commit: base 0.95; +0.04 msg contains bead ID; -0.10 >20 files (shotgun); -0.05 all-test-files. Clamp [0,1].
- MethodRanges validation: co_committed [.85,.99] explicit_id [.70,.99] temporal_author [.20,.85]. CombineConfidence: max as base + headroom*0.1*score per extra signal, cap 0.99. Levels: >=.90 very high >=.75 high >=.50 moderate >=.30 low. MergeCommits dedup SHA+BeadID keeping highest-confidence method.
- Signal weights: co_commit=50 message_match=40 timing=25+author=15 file_overlap=min(files*5,15) proximity=7 when conf>range.max*0.9.

5 DISK CACHES (all goccy-equivalent serde_json, flock/fs2 locking, pass-1 no-rewrite-on-pure-hit, persist-only-fresh):
1. report correlation_report_cache.json: <=6 entries, 24h, 64MB ceiling, key headSHA:beadsHash:optsHash.
2. HEAD-artifact: same bounds, key headSHA:optsHash (EXCLUDES beadsHash so working-tree edits hit).
3. per-commit-event: 30d, <=4000 commits, 96MB, namespace primaryFile+NUL+beadID, entry validates stored OIDs.
4. per-commit-cocommit: same bounds, namespace sha256(excludePathspecArgs joined NUL).
5. analysis (Phase 2c crate).

FEEDBACK STORE: <beadsDir>/correlation_feedback.jsonl append-only 0644, key (sha,beadID) last-write-wins, CorrelationFeedback{commit_sha,bead_id,feedback_at,feedback_by,type,reason,original_conf}; stats accuracy confirmed/(confirmed+rejected).

title: Phase 4a: correlation extractor (snapshot + legacy paths, cat-file batch)
description:
Plan §4.5 extraction half. Most dangerous git-I/O subsystem — standalone CP-CORR gate.

EXTRACTION DISPATCH: stat followed blob (git cat-file -s HEAD:<file>); size >=64KiB or undeterminable -> SNAPSHOT path; else legacy patch path.
- SNAPSHOT: git log --raw --no-abbrev --follow [--since/--until/-nN] -c color.ui=false --format=%H%x00%aI%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%s -- <primary>; parse raw status lines (zero-SHA sides dropped); blobs streamed via ONE long-lived git cat-file --batch with strict interleave + LRU memory window by lastUse (#182). recordLineSet = 64-bit hash multiset of lines starting '{'; synthesized record diffs must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to legacy unified=0 output.
- LEGACY retained for differential testing: git log -p --unified=0 --follow.
- Events: created/claimed/closed/reopened/modified. claimed = ->in_progress (reopened if from closed/tombstone); ->closed|tombstone = closed; open from closed-like = reopened; else modified. Within-commit events sorted by bead ID.
- BeadID filter pushes -G'id':\s*'quoted-id' into git log args.
- Co-commit: 27 code extensions (.go .py .js .ts .jsx .tsx .rs .java .kt .swift .c .cpp .h .hpp .rb .php .cs .scala .yaml .yml .json .toml .md .sql .sh .bash .zsh); excluded prefixes [.beads/ .bv/ .git/ node_modules/ vendor/ __pycache__/ .venv/ venv/ dist/ build/ .next/] via :(exclude,glob) pathspecs; TWO batch passes git log --no-walk=unsorted --name-status and --numstat (mutually exclusive flags); per-commit fallback git show; rename '{old => new}' regex + ' => ' suffix handling; only claimed/closed events correlate (ExtractAllCoCommits).
- Timeout threading: EVERY git call takes deadline context (triage prologue <=10s, BV_ROBOT_HISTORY_TIMEOUT_MS, 0=unbounded) — Rust Command + kill_on_drop + wait_timeout.
- Incremental: threshold 100 new commits else full refresh; git rev-list --reverse sha..HEAD; batch extract via git log --format=<header> --no-walk <SHAs>.

ACCEPTANCE (=CP-CORR): on real repo + synthetic git fixtures — event count, method_distribution, confidence histogram (0.1 buckets), cache hit/miss ratio ALL match Go; cold/warm blob-fetch counts match Go test patterns.
close_reason: Slice 1 complete: legacy git log -p extraction path with exact Go header format, event classification (created/claimed/closed/reopened/modified), sorted-ID deterministic emission, -G bead filter. Live-tested against this repo's history. title: Phase 4c: orphan/file-index/network/causality/related surfaces
description:
Plan §4.5 surfaces built atop extractor+caches.

- ORPHAN DETECTION: git log --no-merges excluding .beads/* paths (legacy-git retry without exclude pathspec). Suspicion weights: fix/close/resolve=10 implement=8 add=5 #\d+=15 [a-z]{2,5}-\d+=20 bv-x=25 beads?\d+=25; probable-bead candidates with reasons[]; defaults min score 30 (--orphans-min-score).

- IMPACT ANALYSIS: risk_level/risk_score for modifying given file set (--robot-impact comma-separated).
- RELATED WORK: four relation types (file-overlap, commit-overlap, dependency-cluster, concurrent-window 7d); relevance 0-100; defaults MinRelevance 20 MaxResults 10; include-closed flag.
- BLOCKER CHAIN: root blockers + chain walk + has_cycle flag (--robot-blocker-chain).
- IMPACT NETWORK: nodes/edges from shared-commit/shared-file/dependency edges; community clusters w/ label, internal_connectivity, central_bead; stats incl density/isolated_nodes; depth-limited subnetwork 1-3 default 2 (--robot-impact-network all|id).

description:

title: Post-release: activate Go upstream sync policy (monthly audit cadence)
description:
Operationalizes plan §3.2 upstream sync policy — currently only prose in the plan.

AFTER v0.21.0-rust ships (CP-F):
1. Monthly audit: diff Go upstream since last audited SHA; categorize changes: bugfixes in algorithms/loader (cherry-pick candidates) / new features (backlog beads) / breaking robot-schema changes (escalate — contract decision needed).
2. Cherry-pick compatible fixes -> regenerate affected goldens from NEW Go binary -> differential must pass before merging.
3. crates/bv-graph-wasm: re-copy + re-diff when its upstream counterpart moves (cheap verbatim path).

5. Quarterly: reassess whether to cut a new parity tag (v0.22-rust...) or fold fixes into v2 track.

WHY A BEAD: without an owner+cadence this silently rots and goldens drift from reality — the exact failure mode §3.2 exists to prevent.

title: TUI-M1: core journey — open/load/list/detail/filter/quit (weeks 1-2)

title: TUI-M4: background worker + live reload infrastructure (week 7)
description:
Plan §6 Phase 6 TUI-M4 (week 7). Infrastructure week — behavioral parity with Go background mode.

WORKER THREAD DESIGN (std::thread + crossbeam-channel replacing goroutine+chan):
- Constants (env-overridable): debounce 200ms BV_DEBOUNCE_MS; message buffer 8 BV_CHANNEL_BUFFER; heartbeat 5s BV_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_S; watchdog 10s BV_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_S; heartbeat-timeout 30s; freshness warn 30s BV_FRESHNESS_WARN_S / stale 120s BV_FRESHNESS_STALE_S; worker poll tick 120ms driving spinner; idle GC enabled.
- Pipeline: file event -> debounce -> load+validate -> Phase1 metrics sync in worker -> Phase2 async per-metric -> immutable DataSnapshot assembled -> ArcSwap pointer-swap to UI.
- Messages: SnapshotReadyMsg{snapshot,file_change_at,sent_at,version,queue_depth,coalesce_count} | SnapshotErrorMsg{err,recoverable} | Phase2UpdateMsg{data_hash}.
- Stale-drop: Phase2UpdateMsg with data_hash != current snapshot dropped.
- Snapshot swap protocol: capture selected IDs (list+board), clear attention overlay, exit time-travel, O(1) swap, return old pooled allocations, reset caches (label health/attention/drilldown/priority hints), recompute alerts + reset dismissals, semantic cache reset + optional hybrid rebuild, update sub-views preserving selection/recipe (applyRecipe vs direct ListItems when RecipeName+Hash match).
- Self-heal watchdog: repeated error phases shown as 'bg <phase> (Nx)'; watchdog recovery counter 'recovered xN'; unresponsive detection 'worker unresponsive'.
- Status indicators: fresh-age warning at 30s '⚠ 45s ago'; STALE at 120s; spinner frames while busy.
- Live reload: notify watcher watching FILE'S DIRECTORY with basename filter (atomic-rename reliability); remote-FS detect -> PollWatcher fallback (BV_FORCE_POLLING/BV_FORCE_POLL force); poll interval 2s comparing mtime+size+existence.
- ctrl+r/F5 force refresh 1s-throttled.

ACCEPTANCE: edit .beads/issues.jsonl externally -> list updates without restart <1s; kill -STOP worker -> watchdog indicators appear then recover on SIGCONT.
close_reason: Background worker ported: std::thread + crossbeam-channel (Go goroutine+chan parity), env-overridable constants matching Go exactly, WorkerMsg enum (SnapshotReady/SnapshotError/Phase2Update), Freshness enum w/ threshold semantics, polling watcher with debounce, shutdown via AtomicBool. 291 tests green; pushed 6c8c395.
